text:
anna-partnerships: Quick heads-up — Nimbus cloud asked for a private offer: 12mo committed spend, want hardware credits (partner-managed GPUs) plus a renewal credit if usage grows >20% year 2. Can we sketch an approach?

sam-sales: thanks. do we know target $ commit size?

anna-partnerships: they signaled $300k ARR commit for Redwood usage, plus they want the SI (CloudForge) to get 8% reseller margin + a joint announcement.

mike-revops: two immediate questions: 1) marketplace fee/commission stacking with SI margin — is that covered? 2) how do HW credits differ from Redwood consumption credits?

lee-legal: flag — any joint announcement needs pre-approved boilerplate and logos. also need to avoid implying SLA changes.

sita-engineering: technically we can support a renewal credit trigger based on token consumption growth. we already have the metric pipeline. runtime-wise: prefer granting credits applied to Hosted API usage, not raw hardware.

sam-sales: proposal draft: commit $300k for 12mo -> 18% off hosted list + $30k hardware credit applied as one-time marketplace credit. SI gets 8% on their linked private-offer line item. Renewal: if usage growth >20% Y2, provide a one-time 5% spend credit on renewal. thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike-revops: numbers look ok but watch margin. If SI margin is 8% we should net it in model. Also marketplace fees eat ~3-5% depending on cloud. So effective revenue = commit - SI - marketplace fees - credits. run sensitivity.

anna-partnerships: can marketing get a tentative co-marketing plan? They want a joint case study timeline aligned with Q4. @mktg-ops-bot any quick checklist?

mktg-ops-bot: checklist: 1) NDA for case study 2) logo approval 3) 2-week review cycle 4) launch webinar slot request.

lee-legal: also add a clause in private-offer: credits are non-transferable, expire after 90 days post-commit year, and do not change SLAs. must include attribution control for joint announcement.

sita-engineering: on implementation: recommend we create two separate SKU lines in the private offer payload — 1) committed usage SKU with discount applied, 2) marketplace-credit SKU (zero-price line with negative adjustment) for the HW credit so accounting lines reconcile. Example payload snippet:
```
{"sku_commit": "redwood-hosted-commit-12mo", "discount_pct": "18"}
{"sku_credit": "hw-credit-nimbus", "amount_usd": "30000", "expiry_days": "90"}
```

sam-sales: good call. also want a clause about renewal cadence + early-exit pro-rata. we shouldn't give full HW credit if they churn mid-year.

mike-revops: finance needs to approve the renewal credit trigger formula. propose: renewal_credit = min(0.05 * renewal_commit, 0.5 * year1_overage_value). keeps exposure bounded.

anna-partnerships: love that. action items: 1) Mike — run margin/sensitivity with marketplace fee and SI cut (ETA EOD). 2) Lee — draft private-offer legal addendum + co-marketing boilerplate (ETA 48h). 3) Sita — confirm SKU naming and expiry mechanim (ETA 24h). 4) Sam — prep commercial slide for Nimbus with the 18% + $30k HW credit and renewal trigger.

sam-sales: will do. ping me if finance pushes back. :thumbsup:

mike-revops: starting the calc now, will post a short table here once done.

lee-legal: will start draft and post redlines.

sita-engineering: will add SKU and a short deploy playbook for marketplace private-offer configuration.

anna-partnerships: thanks everyone. if we can close this week it helps Q3 commit. keeping this thread as the single source for Nimbus negotiation notes. :party:
